metadata.title: Fermented Soy Bean Gravy | Limbu Recipe
metadata.description:
The Limbu people from the hilly regions of Nepal and Darjeeling and Kalimpong districts of India have some pretty amazing cuisine. In this recipe I am making a local delicacy called Kinema Ko Jhol, which is a gravy dish made from fermented soy beans, this is simple and delicious dish that is amazing in taste. This recipe goes down well as a side to steamed rice.
